entities.name: Ambroz Benakov
entities.description: An Orzhov pontiff and corrupt official on Ravnica who extorted vendors.

entities.name: Tanek
entities.description: Thief who tripped Ambroz and took his gold, then was recruited by Radomir to spy.

entities.name: Radomir
entities.description: Boros legionnaire who tracked Tanek and recruited him to spy on Ambroz.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: Guild of which Ambroz is a pontiff.

events.summary: Ambroz makes a pastry chef's wife disappear to claim protection rights and extorts vendors with his thugs.
events.quote: He sent his thugs and blackguards out to extort local vendors

events.summary: Tanek trips Ambroz and snatches a bag of gold.
events.quote: dared to trip the pontiff and snatch a bag of gold from him

events.summary: Radomir tracks down Tanek, returns the gold to Ambroz, and recruits Tanek to spy on Ambroz.
events.quote: he did recruit Tanek to work for him spying upon Ambroz and his cronies

relations.quote: Ambroz Benakov is an Orzhov pontiff and corrupt official on Ravnica
